Text from Ben's own timeline (B:\_powersimple\OmniScience\2020Vision\VideoTimeline.ai, 2019), word for word except three spelling fixes (Jurassic, Internet, Edward -> Eadweard kept as Ben wrote: 'Edward'). kind: media = the story (bright cards), context = the world around it (dim cards, smaller). img = a public-domain picture from Ben's 2020Vision\assets folder. events.t: Hannah Stilley Gorby Born
Mozart was Born
Beethoven was Born
U.S. Declaration of Independence
US Constitution
Mozart Died
White House Burned
Liberia founded
View from the Window at Le Gras, Joseph Nicéphore Niépce
Beethoven Died
British Slavery Abolition Act
Stereoscopic Images
94 Year Old Hannah Stilley Gorby Photographed
Lenticular Stereoscope
First Recording of a human voice by Édouard-Léon Scott de Martinville's Photo Autograph
The Dircksian Phantasmagoria, the effect known as “Pepper's Ghost” invented.
First Color Photo of Agen, France, Louis Ducos du Hauron, Edison invents phonograph
First Motion Picture “Race Horse” by Edward Muybridge
First Radio Broadcast
Charles Urban launches Kinemacolor the first color motion picture process.
“The Jazz Singer” First 'Talkie' Motion Picture with sound.
First Television Broadcast RCA and First Olympics was Televised
First Technicolor Movie “The Wizard of Oz”, View-Master at World's Fair
Video Tape Recorder invented by Ampex
Stereoscopic - 3D Motion Pictures
First Live Color TV Broadcast from Washington, D.C.
First CGI Animation and first Head Mounted Display
First Augmented Reality Display - Ivan Sutherland's “Sword of Damocles”
First IMAX Demonstration - Expo '70, Osaka
Denis Gabor wins Nobel Prize in Physics for “The Holographic Method”
Panasonic prototypes the first HDTV at 1125p
First CGI Animation in a movie “Future World”
First Digital Video Standard - H.120, 176x144 resolution @ 2/MBs
JPEG Format Patented
First Volumetric Capture - Industrial Light & Magic - The Abyss
First photo-realistic CGI “Jurassic Park”
First Viral Internet Video - “Jesus vs. Santa Claus”, later becomes South Park
First Digital Television Broadcast
MPEG-4 Standard- H.264 4096x2048 resolution @ 960MB/s
First Feature Film Shot in all Digital “Star Wars Ep. II - Attack of the Clones”
First LiDAR Point Cloud Animation, Radiohead's “House of Cards”
Volumetric Video Capture of Holocaust Testimonials - USC Shoah Foundation
First Feature Film Shot in all IMAX “Avengers: Infinity War”
Volumetric Video on the web
